title.zh: Zcash's Wall Street Moment Reaches Europe With Its First ETP Listing
title.en: Zcash's Wall Street Moment Reaches Europe With Its First ETP Listing

current_state.zh: 21Shares launched Europe's first Zcash exchange-traded product on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam under the ticker ZCASH with a 2.5% annual fee, a debut that coincided with a sharp intraday spike and subsequent ~6.6% pullback in ZEC.
